{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"0000000000000CJ6HD41AQDMD5","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram kind=sequence
node Page "RdfMemory (page)"
node Host "RdfHostLayer"
node Store "QuadStore"
node Feed "facts feed"
node Db "host SQLite"
edge Page calls Host "write(batch)"
edge Host calls Store "write"
edge Store -> Feed "append batch"
edge Feed -> Store "read back"
edge Store -> Db "apply + cursor (1 tx)"
edge Store returns Host "batch id"
edge Host returns Page "batch id"
note Page "pushes facts to rules, queues events"
